variants.prompt: In the dimly lit foyer of a chic Stockholm nightclub, Ava's icy demeanor melts as she gazes out at the pulsating crowd from behind a velvet rope. A sleek, form-fitting black dress hugs her curvaceous figure, the plunging neckline and high slit revealing tantalizing glimpses of her skin. Her eyes, smoky with seduction, meet the viewer's with a sultry invitation, as if beckoning them into her private world of forbidden pleasure.
